description: Actions naming no store path get the same key on macOS and Linux. Put turnkey-os/turnkey-arch/turnkey-env in remote_execution_properties of the turnkey execution platform; they enter Command.platform and the key even for local-only actions. Salt coarseness is an open decision on the epic. See docs/research/remote-execution-and-caching.md (commit adc3619d) §5.
title: Salt action keys by OS, arch and environment via platform properties (G3)
